## Executive Summary
The provided code defines a method that handles empty stream scenarios by delegating to another method with a spliterator. It exists to provide a convenient way to supply fallback values when a stream is empty.

## Purpose & Responsibility
Purpose: To offer a varargs-based convenience method for handling empty stream conditions.
Responsibility:
- Provides a simplified API for supplying default values when streams are empty
- Converts varargs input into a spliterator for internal processing
- Delegates the actual empty-handling logic to another method

## Key Capabilities
- Accepts variable number of arguments as potential fallback values
- Converts the arguments into an ordered spliterator
- Returns a StreamEx object for further stream operations
